'''''Reesbon''''' was one of seven [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]] launched from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thokos]] more than ten thousand years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The ''Reesbon'', along with six other colony [[Starship/Legends|ships]]&mdash;''[[Almowri]]'', ''[[Glayyd]]'', ''[[Melchett]]'', ''[[Odoon]]'', ''[[Owphrin]]'', and ''[[Tikeris]]''&mdash;eventually landed on the planet [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]] and lost contact with the outside [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The inhabitants of the ships evolved into the world's ruling clans, named after the ships that brought them to Ammuud. The [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] aboard the ''Reesbon'' became the [[Reesbon clan]].<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
